audit.audit_verdict: CLASS-D, PARTIALLY beats deflation, LOW compression, beats NO baseline on empirical content. COMPRESSION: low. The matter leg (CD_tau decomposition, KL form, CD=0<=>lumpable at tau=1, NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT) is PROVED and parameter-rigid as an identity, but it compresses nothing beyond recovering Kemeny-Snell. The QM leg adds rather than removes assumptions: the load-bearing bridging lemma CD_tau>0<=>Unresolved(Pi,r_tau) is in NO paper (flagged absent by both R029 and R007; Cast does not cite Foundations IV F23), Stable() is an undischarged primitive, and the quantum-branch binding crosses MISS_BORN+MISS_LENS_SEL+MISS_COLLAPSE. Free-parameter count does not drop with the unification; the only saving is conceptual naming. HIDDEN IMPORT through the bridges is HIGH: the dephasing-record binding imports the pointer basis it claims to locate, m IS the imported Born measure, Stable() smuggles the perturbation class. BASELINE: does not merely repackage a known unification, but is strictly weaker than the decoherence program on basis selection (decoherence derives einselection; U003 takes the basis free) and below EFT on the matter leg (NG_LADDER_IDEM forbids the RG semigroup). Genuine value-add over baselines is narrow and real: (1) ONE exact computable scalar whose zero-set vs positive-set partitions a layer into definite-object vs measure-slot, (2) the exact intrinsic/manufactured noise split, (3) Lean anchoring. ANTI-SUPERFICIAL: 6 of 7 controls FAIL (same_word, shared_mechanism, bridge_map, hidden_import, elasticity, compression) -- both sectors are the same quotient-by-fibers lemma, the lens and weights are free (opposite-world ELASTIC, inherited from R007/R001), and the decisive QM bridge map cannot be written. The ONE control that PASSES is surprise: the forbiddance corollary (CD_tau=0 forbids a nondegenerate probability record on that fiber) is a genuine new cross-sector exclusion -- 'definite object XOR measure, read off one exact scalar' -- that neither lumpability theory nor F23 supplies alone. NET: a genuine single-primitive LOCATION dichotomy that half-beats deflation, with one provable missing lemma (the bridging proposition + forbiddance corollary on a finite Markov surrogate) as the honest deliverable, the Born rule isolated to the single free weight m it does NOT produce, and the quantum binding correctly quarantined as a conjecture on the disclaimed repair frontier. The defensible artifact is the substrate-neutral core (matter sector + bridging lemma + forbiddance corollary + the CD_1~4.34e-17 resolved vs 0.0482 unresolved figure), explicitly NOT a Born-rule derivation and NOT a quantum result.
